capabilities: Render progress bars from chrono code blocks with start and end times
Show remaining time with selectable units and update intervals
Customize bar names, percentage, and date labels per bar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize the progress of a time range, such as a workday or an event countdown, inside a note.
summary: Renders time-based progress bars in notes via code blocks, showing elapsed percentage and remaining time between a start and end time.
